notes: Step 1 parts were correct; no parts added or dropped.
Circuit: pin 9 -> orange wire -> breadboard column 3 (row g) -> 220 ohm resistor (3h to 6h) -> LED anode at 6i; LED cathode at 8i -> column 8 (row h) -> black wire -> Uno GND.
In the image the breadboard half that is drawn on top is labelled rows f-j, so it is bank 'b' in the catalogue naming; the LED, resistor and wire holes all sit in this half.

Breadboard positions are read from the image. The resistor legs are in columns 3 and 6, the LED legs in columns 6 (bent, longer leg = anode) and 8 (cathode), the orange wire ends in column 3 and the black wire in column 8.
The GND header pin next to pin 13 is mapped to GND.1; the manual does not say which GND pin.
